acip: MA GRUB NA, DNGOS PO'I SPYI DANG BYE BRAG GNYIS KA MA YIN PA CHOS CAN, SHES BYA'I BYE BRAG MA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING SHES BYA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, dngos po'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka ma yin pa chos can, shes bya'i bye brag ma yin par thal, khyod ma yin zhing shes bya yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that that which is neither a quality of working things nor something characteristic of them is not something that could ever be characteristic of a knowable thing. Suppose you do disagree. Let's then again consider that which is neither a quality of working things nor something characteristic of them. It is so the case that it could never be something characteristic of a knowable thing, Because it is not the case that there are many examples of things which are not it, but which are still a knowable thing.
